title: Advancing Automated Ethical Profiling in SE: a Zero-Shot Evaluation of LLM Reasoning
benchmark_measurement: The benchmark did not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measured LLM reasoning on 30 ethically charged scenarios based on secular ethical theories (utilitarianism, deontology, virtue ethics).
findings: The paper does not contain any findings related to religion, as its focus is on secular ethical reasoning in the context of software engineering.
